stem: Why does the poet include descriptive language in these lines?
instruction: Read lines 5 through 9 of the poem.

options.label: F
options.text: To persuade the reader to spend more time outdoors

options.label: G
options.text: To tell the reader that air can smell like many things after it rains

options.label: H
options.text: To explain how the smell of roses is different from the smell of skunk

options.label: J
options.text: To emphasize that air can be both pleasant and unpleasant

visual_elements: Air smells like roses sometimes, or fresh-cut grass; gasoline or rain or skunk.
